questions.H1_LUTTER_ON_OUR_MACHINERY: Do LMAO v0.6.0 outputs meet LMAO's own testcases.bash expectations when run on OUR Classic engines (MALBOLGE/malbolge.py oracle and MALBOLGE/intermediate_vm_runner.exe)?

external_oracle.license: GPLv3, used only as external oracle, not vendored into lmao-lite
external_oracle.build: win_bison -d lmao.y; win_flex --wincompat lmao.l; gcc -O2 all src/*.c (mingw-winlibs); winflexbison v2.5.25 zip sha256 8d324b62be33604b2c45ad1dd34ab93d722534448f55a16ca7292de32b6ac135

spec_source: LMAO testcases.bash (expected values written by LMAO authors, not by us)

spec.example_simple_cat: input 256 seeded random bytes: first 256 output bytes == input (infinite loop: run with fuel, status OUT_OF_FUEL accepted)
spec.example_cat_halt_on_eof: input 256 seeded random bytes: output == input exactly, HALTED

spec_notes:
testcases.bash compares via $(...), which strips trailing newlines; digital_root/adder expectations are therefore compared after stripping trailing 
/ from stdout. Random bytes: random.Random(20260913).
fuel_rule: OUT_OF_FUEL on a halting spec is NOT_EVALUABLE for that engine (not FAIL), except example_simple_cat where it is expected

lmaolite.driver: lmaolite_driver.zig in this folder: parse -> resolveLayout -> emit, exactly the calls used by malbolge-free tests; no changes to lmao-lite

prior_exposure_disclosed: Read hell.zig emit/layout before freezing: sequential placement from cell 0, no ENTRY, no initialization code, first command of xlat2 cycles only, data values restricted to 33..126, XLAT2 filler characters.
Read t_a6_cat.zig: checks 12 printable chars and label positions; never executes the cat.
Expectation stated before running: H2 FAIL for all 6 (most likely at emit or load). Stated so that a PASS would be a genuine surprise.
LMAO outputs have been assembled (sizes seen) but NOT executed on any engine.

verdicts.H1: PASS iff every spec check passes on both engines (NOT_EVALUABLE checks listed separately and do not count as PASS)
verdicts.H2: per program: PASS iff lmao-lite output meets the spec on the oracle; global PARITY_PASS iff 6/6, else FALSIFIED with the stage of failure per program
verdicts.A5_GATE: PASS iff H1 PASS and H2 PARITY_PASS
